title: Marathon
synopsis: Bungie’s Marathon, retained as a permanent digital holding under the archive Steam account — an account-bound edition kept for continuity of access and custody.

custody.physical: Digital edition · Steam · permanent account custody
custody.condition: Account-bound digital copy retained under the archive Steam account. No physical object accompanies this filing.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through the Steam client under the archive account
preservation.compatibility: Access depends on Steam account custody and continued storefront availability. The retained license is the archive’s primary access path.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency, storefront policy change, and client obsolescence. No physical disc or offline installer is held for this filing.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released March 5, 2026 on Steam. This filing records the archive’s retained digital edition rather than a discrete retail object.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account. Continuity of access depends on that account and on Steam’s continued service for the title.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
